subject: POC plan, success criteria, and final readout scheduling - NovaCare
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jones <sara.jones@novacare.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novacare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-25T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed POC plan (next steps)

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the proposed POC plan so we can align on success criteria and ownership: 

1) Goal: Validate that Redwood inference reduces token cost by >=30% on your claims-normalization pipeline while keeping 99th-pct latency under 450ms for 512-token inputs.
2) Scope: 2 model endpoints (claims-normalizer v1, reranker), 2-week trial against a 10k-record sample you provide.
3) Success criteria (proposed):
   - Cost reduction >=30% measured by per-token billing for the sampled traffic
   - 99th-pct latency <450ms for representative requests
   - No functional regressions on top-3 user flows (normalized output parity >95% on your validation set)
4) Evaluation plan: Redwood will provision a dedicated trial pool, run continuous batching, and provide a daily digest + a final results spreadsheet. You’ll run your validation scripts and provide feedback.
5) Timeline: provision + baseline runs (3 business days), trial execution (10 business days), final readout and exec review in week following.
6) Owners: Redwood (Marissa for coordination, Marcus for runtime/SE support), NovaCare (Sara primary, Tom backup for DevOps).

I attached a short POC scope doc and a template for the results spreadsheet. Please confirm the success criteria above or suggest additions (e.g., throughput targets, specific regression checks). Once we align I’ll lock the timeline and schedule the final readout.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0138
[Attachment: poc_scope.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sara Jones <sara.jones@novacare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novacare.com>, DevOps Team <devops@novacare.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed POC plan (next steps)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan. This looks good overall. A couple of items from our side: 

- Please include memory footprint (GB/GPU) as a tracked metric — our infra team cares about peak VRAM during inference.
- Can we add an additional success gate: cold-start latency <200ms for single-request bursts?
- For samples, we’ll send the 10k file by EOD Tuesday.

Timeline-wise we’re OK with the proposed cadence but need the baseline runs to start no earlier than Monday 6/29 (our DevOps is on a maintenance window this weekend).

If that works, confirm and we’ll schedule the final readout window for the week of 7/20 for an exec-level review.

—Sara
Sara Jones
VP, Product Analytics | NovaCare Health
sara.jones@novacare.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Jones <sara.jones@novacare.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novacare.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: NovaCare POC — owners, metrics, schedule

Team —

Following Sara’s asks, please see updated plan we’ll run for NovaCare POC: 
- Baseline + trial start: provision Monday 2026-06-29 (Marissa to confirm once infra is ready).
- Data: NovaCare sends 10k sample by EOD 6/30.
- Metrics to capture: per-token cost, p50/p95/p99 latency, 99th-pct latency target <450ms, cold-start latency (single request) target <200ms, peak VRAM usage.
- Owners: Marcus (runtime tuning + baseline kernels), Neha (instrumentation + results spreadsheet), Rishi (account-level billing/config).

Attachments: updated poc_scope.pdf includes VRAM and cold-start rows. Marcus — can you confirm we can capture peak VRAM from the trial nodes and add a short script to log cold-start times? If so I’ll confirm tentative schedule with NovaCare and lock readout week 7/20.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jones <sara.jones@novacare.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novacare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-10T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Scheduling final readout — week of 2026-07-20

Hi Sara / Tom —

We’re on track with the POC execution and should have the full results ready for an executive readout the week of 7/20. Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue 2026-07-21 10:00–10:45 — technical readout + Q&A (preferred)
- Wed 2026-07-22 15:00–15:45 — exec summary call

Please confirm which window works for the NovaCare execs, and who should be invited from your side (VP/CTO/Procurement). We’ll prepare a short slide pack and the results spreadsheet ahead of the call.

Thanks —
Marissa
[Attachment: poc_results_summary.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Sara Jones <sara.jones@novacare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novacare.com>, DevOps Team <devops@novacare.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Scheduling final readout — week of 2026-07-20

Marissa —

Quick update from our side after reviewing the trial results: 
- NovaCare Execs reviewed the technical readout. We met the cost and latency gates and peak VRAM was within acceptable limits. Cold-start is marginal but within tolerable range for our use case.
- Decision: GO — we want to proceed to contracting for a dedicated capacity pilot. Procurement asked for a statement of work + contract redlines.

Next steps for Redwood: please share the SOW draft and a commercial proposal (term, committed capacity, pricing) and we’ll loop in procurement. Suggested timeline: draft SOW by 7/23, procurement review week of 7/27.

Thanks to the Redwood team — Marcus and Neha in particular for the quick turnaround on instrumentation and results.

—Sara
Sara Jones
VP, Product Analytics | NovaCare Health
sara.jones@novacare.com
